findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_salon_availability" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_providers, list_clients, get_client · Private data: list_salons, get_salon, list_providers, list_appointments, get_appointment, list_calendar_events, list_payments, list_quotes, show_salon_overview · Public sink: list_clients, get_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_providers, list_clients, get_client · Private data: list_salons, get_salon, list_providers, list_appointments, get_appointment, list_calendar_events, list_payments, list_quotes, show_salon_overview · Public sink: list_clients, get_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
